unsupported_wording: In TIA 23-2, the 3 ft rooftop spacing applies only to individual units of 20 kWh or less; the claim omits this. The roof-edge rule is 'equal to system height, but not less than 5 ft', and TIA 23-2 also sets a 10 ft (3 m) clearance from the rooftop fire-service access point. The TIAs do not print the 15.3.1 reference cleanly (it reads '9.1.515.13', an apparent typo). Not verified here: the Hydro One quote, the code-citation statements (NFC, BCFC, VBBL, BCBC, NFC-AE) and the 'UL ___/___A' pair (only UL 9540A is seen).
note: Code-absence statements rely on Claude's own earlier check of local texts and are outside these sources.
